title: ELITE MACHINES GET AN OUTLINE
why: His playtest answer on the elites was tint and/or outline. An elite machine now wears a clean outline in its colour (cyan shielded, orange volatile, yellow fast, green mender) with a faint tint over the body, so it reads as special at a glance. The two heavy rings and the glow on the ground are one thin ring now.
now: Elite machines now wear a clean coloured outline and a faint tint, and one thin ring on the ground.
